text: The Patriots' Week 3 matchup against the Jaguars at Everbank Stadium on Sunday at 1 PM ET arrives with a roster in flux following what amounted to a defensive showcase in last week's 20-3 victory over the Steelers, where TreVeyon Henderson found the end zone but the offense continued to sputter in ways that would have been unthinkable during last season's Super Bowl run. The injury front has grown more complicated this week, with starting right guard Mike Onwenu sidelined by a broken right ankle, while safety Dell Pettus has been placed on injured reserve, forcing the team to shuffle its lineup by promoting linebacker Jose Ramirez from the practice squad and adding linebacker Benton Whitley to the practice squad. Head Coach Mike Vrabel will address these roster decisions and the team's ongoing offensive struggles during the week ahead, as the Patriots look to build on their defensive dominance while searching for the kind of offensive rhythm that defined their championship season.
